messages:
Maria: anyone else seeing a spike of apiserver 5xx in eu-west1? started ~15:40 UTC, short bursts every 30-90s
AJ: yup saw alerts. controller-manager leader keep flipping between cp-01/cp-03 a few times
Maria: logs showing etcd raft election timeouts around the same times
Maria: paste of etcd log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T15:39:12Z etcdserver: raft: election timeout reached, resetting election timer
2026-03-18T15:39:12Z etcdserver: rafthttp: failed to send to peer 7f3a...: write tcp 10.10.1.5:2380->10.10.1.7:57432: write: connection reset by peer
2026-03-18T15:39:13Z etcdserver: increased term to 28
```
Liam: disk iowait spike at those times? iostat shows heavy write queue on cp-03
Liam: `avg-cpu: %idle  20.1
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s  r/s  w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s  avgrq-sz  avgqu-sz  await  svctm  %util
iotop: sdb  98%`
Devon: could be compaction snapshot activity + backups colliding with leader heartbeats. compaction window is 15:30 UTC currently right?
Maria: yes compaction cron is 15:30 daily, but bursts were every ~30s not a single big event
AJ: maybe small compactions + snapshot backlog cause sustained IO and drop raft messages -> election timeouts
SRE-bot: ALERT: controlplane-leader-churn eu-west1 (severity:high) @channel
Devon: quick mitigation: throttle compaction or move it to later, and cordon cp-03 from scheduling backups for 30m
Maria: doing a targeted restart of kube-apiserver on cp-03 now (rolling)
Maria: `kubectl drain cp-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
AJ: also bumping etcd heartbeat from 100ms -> 150ms temporarily to reduce sensitivity (will patch via kcm-config)
Liam: pulled metrics, raft msg receive latency spike aligns with iowait. looks like writes are blocking network threads
Maria: applied compaction cron change to 03:30 UTC and paused backup jobs for 1h
Devon: will monitor leader churn graph and the apiserver 5xx rate
SRE-bot: RESOLVE: controlplane-leader-churn eu-west1 (severity:high) -> status:mitigated (actions: compaction moved, cp-03 restarted, backups paused)
Maria: current apiserver 5xx rate down to baseline, leader stable 12m and counting
AJ: follow-up: file ticket to stagger compaction + snapshots across controlplane nodes and add iops alert for cp disks
Liam: +1  also add postmortem note about ethdisk iops threshold and consider moving snapshots to slower window
Devon: created JIRA INFRA-8943 with action items
Maria: nice work :thumbsup:
